name: Coupons+ | Smart BOGO, Bundles, Gifts, Automatically Apply + more Advanced WooCommerce Coupons & Discounts
author: neblabs

sections.description:
NEW: Bundle Discounts! Create complex bundles and combo discounts using Coupons+ Core. *Applied as coupon discounts.

✔ Fully supports the lastest PHP version: 8.5.12
✔ Actively Maintained & Supported: Averaging 1 update per week for the past 2 months! Always backwards compatible. Consistently updated with new features, bug fixes and new WooCommerce and PHP versions.

Designed exclusively for offers and discounts

Coupons+ was designed from the ground up for very complex offers and discounts. The result is a beautiful and intuitive, tree-based dashboard powered by a custom-built engine that allows you to create almost any type of offer, visually. With Coupons+ you don’t have to hunt through settings tabs just to find what you need. This plugin is an original concept designed and developed from scratch.

Over a ***billion*** ways to configure an offer

Yes, a billion. With a b. When we say Coupons+ is extremely powerful we really mean it: our custom Grove engine allows you to configure a coupon in not hundreds of millions, but billions of ways. Backed by an extensive suite of automated tests for many scenarios to ensure Coupons+ works reliably to protect your margins and increase your revenue! Such power could only be possible with a purpose-built engine like the one we engineered for Coupons+.

  • 5 offer types!

Key Features

  • Advanced BOGO Deals
    Go beyond basic BOGOs with our advanced offers engine.

    • Target Anything: Apply BOGO offers to specific products, categories, brands, or tags. You can even combine them (e.g., “Buy any two shirts (Category) from Brand A and get a free hat”).
    • Get X (Same Product): Create classic “Buy One, Get One” deals where the customer receives another of the same item for free, a percentage off, a flat discount, or for a fixed price. (e.g., “Buy 1 Hoodie, Get another for FREE”).
    • Get Y (Different Product): Set up promotions like, “Buy Product A and get Product B for free,” perfect for clearing inventory or promoting new items. You can target specific products, categories, brands, or tags for the “Buy” part of the BOGO offer.
    • Apply recursively: Apply your BOGO offers to as many eligible items as possible
    • Multiple offers per set of items
      Apply multiple offers for the same items, for example:
    • ** (buy) Category A: get 10% off + 50% discount on Product A
    • ** (buy) Product A: get Product B FREE + $20 OFF Shipping

  • A Beautiful Builder
    Our elegant, tree-based visual builder lets you create and connect nodes for products, filters, and offers to craft powerful, custom coupon logic without any guesswork.

  • Automatically Applied Coupons
    Create coupons that automatically apply in the cart when their conditions are met. No need for customers to remember or type in a code, reducing friction and increasing conversions.

  • Advanced Discount Rules

    • Brand Discounts: Easily create sales and promotions for specific brands.
    • Quantity-Based Discounts: Target customers based on a specific number of items. Set discounts for an exact quantity, a minimum, a maximum, or a range (e.g., “Buy any 3 items from the T-shirts category and get 20% off”).

  • Advanced Conditions & Scheduling

    • Granular Control: Restrict coupons by user role, payment methods, or shipping methods.
    • Advanced Scheduling: Unlike default WooCommerce coupons, you can set both a start and end date for your coupons, allowing you to schedule promotions in advance. You can even select the start and end hours.

  • Limit by Quantities

    • Apply a discount only when buying a min. qty, like apply an offer when buying 3 or more
    • Limit the discount to specific quantities (10% to 2 items)

  • One-Click Importable Presets
    Choose from dozens of premade presets covering the most common types of offers. Browse our extensive presets catalog and import the one you need right away from the Coupons+ dashboard! No need to sign up for an account or copy and paste code.

Easily create automatic category discounts in WooCommerce

…And not just categories, you can target pretty much anything for your global, automated discounts, like brands, tags, or a bag of products. You can even get super specific by discounting categories only from a specific brand (like 10% off Shoes, but only from Nike). These can apply automatically without customers having to enter a coupon code!

Bundles

Offer bundles and combos discounts in your store. You can target any type of products and quantities eligible for the bundle.

Examples:

  • Buy 2 in the Clothing category for $99.
  • Buy 1 Red T-shirt + 1 Blue T-shirt for $67
  • Buy 1 from the Hoodies category + 2 White T-shirts for $85.

Cart Discounts

Examples:

Apply a discount to the cart subtotal when buying specific product combinations

  • Apply a $10 discount to the cart when:
    • buying 1 of Product A. Eg.: Buy 1 T-shirt and get a $10 discount on your cart.
    • buying 1 in Category A and from Brand B. Eg.: Buy 1 pair of Nike (Brand) Shoes (Category) and get a $10 discount on your cart.
    • buying Product A + Product B. Eg.: Buy 1 T-shirt + 1 Blue Hoodie and get a $10 discount on your cart.
    • buying 2 in Category A + 1 Product B. Eg.: Buy 1 T-shirt + 1 pair of jeans and get a $10 discount on your cart.
    • buying 2 in Category A and Brand B + 1 Product C. Eg.:
    • etc…

Apply a discount to the cart subtotal when buying a minimum quantity for any type of products (Min. qty bulk cart discounts)

  • Apply a $20 discount to the cart subtotal when:
    • buying 5 or more of a specific Product
    • buying any 2 or more of Product A, B, and/or C
    • buying or more of Products in a specific Category and from specific Brands (eg: from 2 or more Nike Shoes)

Help & Support

Documentation

If you’re new to Coupons+, check out our Getting Started with Coupons+ guide to help you get familiar with the plugin.

Community & Support

Need help or running into issues? You can open a support ticket in the Official Coupons+ Support Forums.
sections.faq:
Are there any restrictions?

Absolutely not! All features listed here are 100% ready to use after installation. While you can do even more with Coupons+ Pro, any features listed here have no artificial limitations or restrictions unless otherwise noted. You can create as many coupons, add as many filters, offers and conditions as you need. Anything listed here is and will always be free.

How are one-click presets imported?

We offer a free service that allows you to import ready-to-use presets. These are loaded from our servers at api.neblabs.com. This service is optional to use (opt-in by default), always free and does NOT collect any personally identifiable information from you, the user.

Wait, a *billion* ways? This is only a marketing label, right?

Nope. It’s 100% true. And believe it or not it’s actually a conservative estimate.

The real number is mathematically impossible to calculate.
Coupons+ has been designed as a modular builder. This estimate is the result of the multiplication of the number of possible choices of every component (including, but not limited to: filters, offers, preconditions and groups). The total configuration space scales exponentially into the trillions from all the possible ways they can be combined.

This figure means Coupons+ has the dynamic range to make almost any offer you can imagine possible without having to write custom code.

How do I create automatic category discounts in WooCommerce?

With Coupons+, you can set up an automatic category discount in 4 simple steps:

  1. Create a new coupon.
  2. Add a Categories filter with your desired categories. You can add another filter here (like a Brands filter) if you want to narrow down the selection.
  3. Add a Discount offer and make sure it is set to: Apply to: Filtered Items
  4. Below the Save button, click Manually Applied so that it changes to Automatically Applied and save it.

The discount will apply automatically to all items in those categories in the cart & checkout. The customer will not need to enter a coupon code.
sections.changelog:
1.10.1 – November 26, 2026

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed discount labels on some offers to show decimals (floats).

1.10.0 – November 23, 2026

Features

  • The Grove engine has a new lookahead feature that runs a fast and lightweight simulation that allows the new Purchase Amount condition to exclude BOGO items from its calculations. As a result, Cart Subtotal and Cart Total (from Coupons+ Pro) are now deprecated in favor of the new Purchase Amount condition. Your existing coupons that use Cart Subtotal will continue to work as they have before this change.

Bug Fixes

  • The BOGO: Same Products offer now requires the full set of items to discount to be in the cart for the discount to apply, when on manual mode. Previously, if you had a Buy 2 Get 2 deal, when the customer had 3 eligible items on the cart, the discount would be applied to 1 in the cart. Now the offer requires the cart to have all 2 items to discount, not just 1 or 2 (partial).

  • Dashboard: Fixed screen flows for some contexts, mainly what third party plugins use (Coupons+ Pro for tiers).

1.9.2 – November 09, 2026

Bug Fixes

  • The bugs on the duplicate mode of the BOGO: Same Products offer have been fixed. This mode is still in preview as noted in the UI.

  • Added docs link to the BOGO: Same Products offer.

  • Removed development command labels on the dashboard sidebar.

  • Added support for Coupons+ Pro 3.0.0

  • Added support for ignoring the Quantity filter in any branch that requires it.

  • The repeatedly feature on BOGO: Same Products is now disabled when the experimental mode ‘duplicate’ is selected since that mode is already applied repeatedly.

  • Dashboard: Fixed sidebar position on some sections of the Coupons+ Dashboard.

  • Trimmed Composer dependencies. Coupons+ now ships in a leaner package.

1.9.1 – October 29, 2026

Bug Fixes

  • Added support for Coupon URLs 1.3.4

  • Fixed some conditions not showing up in the dashboard.

1.9.0 – October 25, 2026

Features

  • Added help tab in the dashboard.

  • Added Bundle-related Suggested Scopes to the dashboard.

Bug Fixes

  • Dashboard: automatically centering a tree in the dashboard canvas now considers the dimensions of the sidebar.

  • Enhanced real-time cart state synchronization: the cart totals now reactively recalculate on the fly when incrementing quantities across multi-pass and auto-added BOGO offers.

  • We’ve upgraded the AND filter group algorithm to a Min-Cost Max-Flow network model for maximum reliability. This eliminates “greedy” selection issues where one group might starve another of necessary items. Coupons+ now evaluates filter groups globally as a flow network, guaranteeing optimal item allocation no matter how groups are ordered or how items were added to the cart. This means you can have filters that overlap in different groups and each group will select the most optimal items regardless of the order of the groups or the order of the items in the cart.

  • In both BOGO offers, the default option for When items eligible for discount aren’t in the cart is now Let the customer add them manually. This only applies to new offers added in the dashboard and of course the option can be changed when configuring the offer. Existing offers continue to work the way they were saved before, no change manual change needed.

1.8.0 – October 12, 2026

Features

  • You can now create product filter groups like 1 of Product A + 1 of Product B!

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed dashboard bug that prevent users from deleting values from numeric inputs because of always defaulting to 1 on empty values.

1.7.1 – October 09, 2026

Bug Fixes
* Added wc-price-format dependency on the frontend script

  • Fixed rendering the discount badges on product titles in the mini cart.

1.7.0 – October 09, 2026

Features

  • You can now exclude subcategories when selecting categories in you offers! For example: target all in Clothing except Hoodies. Sub-brands coming later this year.

  • Added a new Suggested Scope: Min. Quantity Bulk Discount. This Suggested Scope will help you set up a bulk discount offer when purchasing a min. quantity. For example, applying a 10% discount T-Shirts when buying 3 or more. This capability already existed but now it’s easier to setup with the help of this new Suggested Scope. We will be adding more Suggested Scopes in the future.

  • New Offer: Bundle Price! You can now create complex bundles, combos and multi-buy offers. This offer has been ported from the pro version to the Core version. Bundle Price will now be free to use forever! We keep committed to making Coupons+ Core the most powerful offers engine for WooCommerce!

  • Added Visual Examples: a new feature that allows you to browse examples to help you better understand Coupons+. This release ships with Bundle Price examples but we expect to add more examples for other offers, as well as Filters and Preconditions. Simply open the Bundle Price offer and select the examples tab.

Bug Fixes
* Fixed wp-admin menus not clicking when the Popup was open (#132). Closes #81.
* Add +1 to the Buy X Get X card to improve clarity.

  • More visual dashboard fixes.

  • Fixed an important bug when calling some WooCommerce APIs: $context = ‘edit’ has now removed from most calls, improving compatibility with other WooCommerce plugins.

  • Removed $context = ‘edit’ from BundlePrice (#145)

1.6.0 – September 30, 2026

Features

  • The dashboard popup has been redesigned: now wider and with a smoother look and feel. It adapts to your content, making configuring your offers easier and better. The Refine Selection screen has been replaced with a sidebar, allowing you to more easily combine your filters and conditions.
  • Several popup bugs have been fixed in this redesign as well.

1.5.0 – September 11, 2026

Features

  • The Dashboard has received a minor redesign: the left sidebar menu has been moved to a top horizontal menu, improving the user experience and giving you more horizontal space in the main offers canvas. More UI improvements are expected in the next releases as we continue to refine the user experience.
  • The “use classic” button has been fixed.

Bug Fixes

  • Removed the global Coupon URLs available extension notification from the dashboard in an effort to declutter the wp admin dashboard. The ext. can be installed from within the Coupons+ dashboard when needed.

  • Improved PHP 8.4 compatibility by resolving “Implicitly marking parameter as nullable”.

  • Fixed undeclared property on app file.
  • Fixed non-cannonical casts (PHP 8.5)
  • Fixed dynamically set property at runtime in FilterableGroupFactory.php not caught by static analysis
  • Passing null as array key in Collections

1.4.0 – September 07, 2026

Features

  • The new presets server is back! Presets are also now grouped by category. This release contains a limited set of presets. More presets will be added in the coming weeks.

1.3.1 – September 01, 2026

Bug Fixes
* Removed danielstjules/stringy. Moved to voku/stringy fork. (#40)

  • Fixed some strings that weren’t been translasted.

  • Coupons+ now ships will all its third party composer dependencies prefixed with our own namespace. This removes the risk of collision with other plugins.

  • Importing from presets has been temporarily disabled untile the new API is ready.

1.2.0

  • NEW: Usage Limits per User condition: you can now limit the number of usages for a single user.

1.1.3

  • More dashboard improvements and bug fixes. Hopefully the dashboard should be super smooth to use now.

1.1.2

UPDATE: updated dashboard ui with more improvements and bug fixes.
FIX: Fixed a bug when the preconditions failed.

1.1.1

NEW: The new contextual product filtering experience is now active! You can now select an offer type when adding a root node. This adjusts the labels and other ui elements to the type of offer you intend to create, making it easier than ever to create and configure your offers. Starting with 3 common types of offers. More offer types will be added in the future.
FIX: Some minor UI bugs and improvements.

1.1.0

*UPDATE: Coupons+ is now faster than ever! Improved the performance of the Grove engine by 1.5x-2x and up to 4x depending on the hardware, cart count, load and database size. But overall, performance has been improved across the board.
*NEW: Added Support for applying offers recursively.
*BuyXGetX (Same Product): Supports applying bogo offers recursively to as many eligible items as possible.
*BuyXGetY (Different Products): Supports applying bogo offers recursively to as many eligible items as possible.
*BuyXGetY (Different Products): Added “any” quantity option to apply a discount to unlimited quantities of the “get” product of the buy one get one offer.
*UPDATE: BOGO nodes (BuyXGetX and BuyXGetY) now support filter groups without a Quantity filter.
*UPDATE: The UI has a brand new but small redesign in some parts of the dashboard with the focus on improving usablity. Also, the new framework for the new Product Filtering Experience has been implemented but is missing promo implementations, so it’s not yet live, but the first implementations will be shipped in the next minor release (tentatively).
*FIX: Fixed, no, SQUASHED some annoying UI bugs.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
